consequence.line: Simone writes little of much consequence
stanza: Simone writes little of much consequence
Unless the theater’s how you pay the rent
A new work of some semi-memoir sits
Inside the weekend book editors desk
And while they have not mentioned it
She must watch roses get thrown at less
Oh, the indignity

consequence.line: There's a price to pay and a consequence
stanza: First there's lights out, then there's lock up

It's their own fault for being timeless

All the galleries, the museums
Here's your ticket, welcome to the tombs
They're just public mausoleums
The living dead fill every room

consequence.line: But then I start to think about the consequences
stanza: But then I start to think about the consequences
'Cause I don't get no sleep in a quiet room

consequence.line: For with that grand collision, came a grave consequence
stanza: If only you had known me before the accident
